answer_1.quote: We introduce German4All, the first large-scale, multi-level paraphrasing corpus for German. The dataset provides paraphrases of source texts across five distinct complexity levels.
answer_1.outputs: paraphrases of source texts across five distinct complexity levels

answer_2.quote: We employed the LLM judge and automatic readability metrics from subsection 4.2 to evaluate them.

answer_3.quote: To acquire a large-scale evaluation of all data samples, we employ an LLM-as-a-judge as automatically evaluating simplification with LLMs has shown good correlation with human judgements in previous work.

answer_4.quote: In total, 16 native German speakers participated in our human evaluation. They participated voluntarily and received no financial compensation.
answer_4.guideline: For each text pair, we asked the following questions with the answer options in parentheses: Q1: Is the content of the original text preserved? Q2: Was information added? Q3: Was information removed? Q5: Is the complexity level appropriate?
